headline: 1953 film: Measuring the dollar's *purchasing power* in soup
quote: Another day, if a dollar will buy only four cans, its value has gone down.
title: 1953 film: How does the price of soup change a dollar's value?
caption: A 1953 educational film explains purchasing power using soup prices. The example shows how fewer goods purchased indicate a weaker dollar.
comment: Does measuring currency against everyday items still work today?
